Re-searched 2026-10-20: ArcGIS Online (a bbox crawl of ~6,600 Illinois-area items, a second bbox-restricted search per county that read ~760 items inside each county's own envelope and found no qualifying polygon layer, per-county title searches, the county's own AGOL organisation by name, every public web map's layer list), the 'Parcels - IL - <County>' index, ArcGIS Hub, the Illinois State Geological Survey statewide service (maps.isgs.illinois.edu, which answers Token Required) and the Prairie Research Institute parcel fabric (a project slice of 20 counties).

Williamson.reason: The county's assessor tax-map service is real and public (WilliamsonIL_PAT_Taxmap/MapServer/0 on ags.bhamaps.com, listed in the 'Parcels - IL' index), but Planyr's relay cannot reach it: Cloudflare answers 526 (the host's TLS certificate chain is rejected from the edge), and the sandbox cannot reach the host directly. Not wired because a source nobody could measure may not ship; B2379936 re-measures it from a browser that accepts the chain (the owner's chat), and wires it if it answers with CORS or through a fixed relay.
